case_name: Vide This Order vs State & Ors.
facts_of_case: Complaint case against respondent for bigamy; trial court discharged respondent; petitioner seeks to set aside order.

legal_principles.principle: The validity of a second marriage must be proved in terms of Section 17 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
legal_principles.held: A second marriage has been barred under Hindu Marriage Act and has been made punishable under Section 494 IPC. The conditions of validity of second marriage are to be considered in terms of Section 17 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
cited_cases: Smt. Priya Bala Ghosh Vs. Suresh Chandra Ghosh, (1971) SCC (Cri.) 362
Kanwal Ram & Ors. Vs. Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72909203/
use_in: cases involving bigamy and adultery charges

legal_principles.principle: Even admission by the accused is no evidence of marriage for the purpose of proving an offence of bigamy and adultery.
legal_principles.held: It was concluded by Hon'ble Court that 'Homo' and 'Saptapati' are essential ceremonies of a valid marriage which should be performed in terms of Section 7 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
cited_cases: Bhaurao Shanker Lokande and Anr. Vs. State of Mahrastra & Anr., AIR 1965 SC 1564
use_in: cases involving bigamy and adultery charges

outcome.final_order: Order of Ld. Trial Court set aside, and charges framed against respondent.
